currentChatPilotCI.boundary: repository/browser compatibility only; not native deployed Apps Script acceptance

remainingGates.name: Exact cleaned release candidate
remainingGates.requirement: Identify and freeze the exact candidate source set, excluding temporary acceptance helpers from any Production candidate.

remainingGates.name: Protected frontend / Command Center / PWA-mobile compatibility
remainingGates.requirement: Run compatibility against the exact release candidate. Existing repository CI supports but does not replace native release-candidate acceptance.

remainingGates.name: Enquiry integration compatibility
remainingGates.requirement: Preserve frontend transport and retry behavior. Live Apps Script persistence/matching/notification acceptance remains separate.

remainingGates.name: Assistant contracts
remainingGates.requirement: Preserve current assistant/context behavior on the exact release candidate.

remainingGates.name: Existing mail projection and email-sync compatibility
remainingGates.requirement: Native subset synthetic projection cases passed. Exact deployed/current mail compatibility still requires the governed Apps Script environment.

remainingGates.name: Deployed DEV transport and real authentication
remainingGates.requirement: Requires supported Apps Script deployment/runtime authentication access. Do not replace with mocks.

remainingGates.name: Full protected legacy suite on exact release candidate
remainingGates.requirement: Reuse accepted native/local evidence where applicable, but execute the remaining exact-candidate protected compatibility gate.

remainingGates.name: Production backup / rollback / promotion / smoke
remainingGates.requirement: Only after all pre-Production release gates pass and explicit Production approval is granted.
